name: whisper-large-v3-swiss-german-mit
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-23. Caveats: the WER win is real but small (1.9 points on dev, 1.6 on final) and the card's own long-form section shows the gap shrinking to 0.20 points on 15-minute recordings. The fine-tune COSTS 0.2-1.1 WER points on FLEURS de/en/fr/it/es, so multilingual users should not take it. Dev half was used for model selection, so 22.1 is a selected number; the final half (24.7 vs 26.3) is the honest figure. MIT licence is the point of the checkpoint - most Swiss German models inherit CC-BY-NC.
